result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but two visual defects stand out: an empty placeholder in the top-right header control and an inconsistently styled favorite (heart) button between the two 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: The circular control in the top-right of the header is an empty light-gray circle with only a small red notification dot — the expected icon (profile avatar or notification bell) is missing, so the button reads as a blank blob and gives no affordance about what it does.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon (avatar image or bell/profile glyph) inside the circle, add an accessible label, and keep the red dot as an overlay badge.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the ramen card uses a white filled circle with a dark outlined heart, while the pizza card uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart, creating visual inconsistency within the same list.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment across all cards (same background fill, heart color, size and position) so the control looks identical regardless of card imagery.
